interpretationLimits: The frame hop gives a 187.5 Hz envelope sampling rate and 93.75 Hz Nyquist; the 21.333 ms Hann analysis window smooths envelope variation, so AM probes and the Hann-squared response define the reported useful band.
30 ERB bands are a sparse STFT grouping, not 30 independent auditory channels; zero-bin bands are listed and not imputed.
The mod residual can contain slow envelope curvature, modal beating and other response changes after linear log-power detrending; it is not exclusively beating.

Energy weighting couples the primary modulation coordinate to coarse ERB-group power balance; per-group weights and residual descriptors are retained for interpretation. A normalized modulation spectrum is phase-free and cannot establish aligned envelope timing identity.
STFT t90 and tail/early ratios describe overlapping frame-power summaries, not physical decay constants or natural termination.
The 36 within and 198 between pairs share Plates and are descriptive dependent comparisons; no inferential tests or listener data are included.
Synthetic cases are engineering controls. Their cross-class pair rows are exploratory and not pooled into natural pair summaries.

representation.decay: OLS dB-power slope (10*log10 pooled group power) over the fixed 50-500 ms center-time window; descriptor only
representation.frameTime: left-aligned frame start n*256/48000; envelope time is window center start + 511.5/48000
representation.fullClipCompanions: normalized t90 from summed 30-band STFT frame energy over complete frames; late/early ratio compares frame centers >=500ms with 50-500ms

high.aggregation: sum linear ERB power before dB

low.aggregation: sum linear ERB power before dB

mid.aggregation: sum linear ERB power before dB

representation.modulation: demean each group OLS residual; weight each group by its share of mean linear group power over the same 84-frame window; pooled spectrum is the weighted sum of group periodograms using a symmetric Hann over 84 frames, restricted to empirical usable bins and unit-summed; pooled residual RMS is the square root of the same energy-weighted mean of per-group residual mean-square values. Unweighted per-group slopes, RMS, and selected-bin periodograms are retained.
representation.oneSidedLinearPower: |rFFT|^2 / sum(Hann)^2; double positive bins; sum by existing 30 equal-ERB-rate 0-8k bins
representation.pairwisePrimary: unit-sum energy-weighted modulation-rate periodogram cosine; phase/order is discarded
representation.stereoPooling: mean left/right linear band power per frame

responseDescriptors.modulationSpectrumUnavailableReason: selected band contains less than 1% of non-DC residual periodogram power
